sources.title: 04a-finetuning-RL.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: In particular, RL allows to fine-tune LLMs towards human preferences and commericial usability, because its mechanics lend itself to training a model based on a more abstract signal whether an output is good or bad (i.e., let it discover how to generate output that recevies a "good" reward!), rather than based on particular demonstrations.
